_readme: Resume state for the newsletter harvest (tools/upkeep-routine.md step 2).
Read this BEFORE a harvest pass; update `last_processed`/`count`/`updated` and COMMIT it after.
This file lives in the repo (not session memory) precisely so a CLOUD agent can clone, resume, and open a PR.
`react-brain lint` cross-checks each `count` against encyclopedia.yaml sources_digested — they must match.
Narrative harvest history (what each pass changed, process learnings) stays in the maintainer's memory ledger.

react-digest.name: React Digest
react-digest.notes: issues slug-titled by featured article; article/depth-driven — durable yield is usually one decision-guide reading. Archive moved: /digests 404s, use /newsletters or /newsletters.rss (newest-first, resolves the slug). Slug numbers are NOT sequential (2316 → 2320 → 2325 → 2330 → 2335)

react-native-rewind.name: React Native Rewind
react-native-rewind.notes: slug-titled; each issue page carries an authoritative 'Issue #NN' label near the title — use THAT, not sequential guesswork, to resume. RSS at /newsletter-rss.xml lists newest-first; canonical host is www.thereactnativerewind.com. #51 = 'GPU-Powered Crayons…' (2026-08-03), a supply-chain/agentic essay issue, 0 keeps — and #50 was also 0 keeps, so this source has shifted away from library releases toward essays

native-weekly.name: Native Weekly
native-weekly.notes: nativeweekly.com is a shell — use the beehiiv archive (slugs like /p/jul-17-2026-issue-17); author also authors rnsec (watch self-promotion); strongest beat = agentic dev tooling. Irregular: STILL no issue after #17 (2026-07-17) as of 2026-08-04 — two consecutive passes with nothing new

react-weekly.name: React Weekly
react-weekly.notes: site + api.react-weekly.dev are JS-shell/auth-gated — harvest via rss.xml content:encoded (FULL bodies). Links inside are api.react-weekly.dev/track/click/<id> redirects: resolve each with `curl -L` before dispositioning. `harvest inventory`/`coverage` return 0 links on the issue URL, so the coverage gate cannot cover this source — the RSS-derived manifest is the record. RSS window = latest 20: a backlog >20 issues loses them permanently (issues 1-7 already unreachable). TanStack-heavy.
